title: Bergen Summer Research School 2027 (BSRS)
field: Interdisciplinary PhD courses (e.g. moral economies of AI and of universal health coverage)
about: The University of Bergen's Bergen Summer Research School runs 7-17 June 2027 in Bergen, Norway, with seven parallel PhD courses, including Moral economies of Artificial Intelligence. Participants choose one course. Application deadline: 1 February 2027.

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "PhD student" → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Moral economies of Artificial Intelligence" (course offered) → "Apply responsible practices for verification, attribution, citation awareness, confidentiality, and academic integrity when using AI in research activities."
